title: Chapter 6262: One Wisp

Chapter 6262: One Wisp

Chapter 6262: One Wisp

Her frightening aura swept and froze the area above the crater for thousands of miles.

"Shit!" Many were caught by it and became ice sculptures. Some didn't have time to scream before meeting this chilling demise.

"She's furious!" They shuddered because her rage alone killed weaker cultivators in the blink of an eye.

"Boom!" However, Crimson Cauldron and Frost didn't have time to attack before two beams erupted and illuminated the crater.

The two new powers were pure and vigorous like two rising suns. Bronze-blade and Coldblade's dao fruit was finally finished and became bright with light unique to emperors.

A new grand dao was born amidst chaos true energy. The sky seemed to be born apart.

"They're doing it!" The crowd yelled excitedly.

"Enough!" Crimson Cauldron's expression soured. Earlier, he cared about his reputation and wanted to intimidate them into leaving.

Alas, time ran out so he had to take action, sending a fiery blast wave forward. If this were in the regular world, it would instantly flatten a hundred thousand miles of land, turning it into lava.

He wanted to destroy the duo instantly and seize their dao fruits.

"Courting death." Li Qiye raised his hand and easily stopped the blast wave, shocking the crowd.

"H-how did he do it..." Many stammered in confusion.

Crimson Cauldron became startled, realizing he was facing a formidable enemy.

"Die!" Ruyi Monarch and Skyraiser Crown Prince didn't want to let the two finish the process so they attacked without warning.

Ruyi Monarch's golden lotus shot out countless petals, surrounding Li Qiye. The crown prince's treasure seal turned into crashing mountains.

Li Qiye seemingly didn't notice the sneak attacks and stood still without reacting.

"Watch out!" A big shot warned him loudly but it was too late.

The mountains and blades struck the target but the result surprised everyone. Li Qiye was completely unharmed while they shattered to pieces.

Ruyi and the crown prince gasped in astonishment. Their weapons crumbled while he was perfectly fine.

"Looks like I have to burn some trash today." Li Qiye shook his head and slowly raised one hand.

Cracks suddenly appeared on the gigantic tree and its branches, giving room to the tribulation flames.

"It's starting, we need to leave!" Black Witch Monarch read the situation perfectly and took the youths with him.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade lost control of their body and were taken as well.

When the group could react, they were far away from the leaf and tree, standing on the highest peak far away.

"Poof!" A wisp of flame heeded Li Qiye's summon and hovered on his palm.

"Roast emperor time?" Li Qiye smiled and blew the wisp toward the opponents.

It looked so weak they didn't think much of it at first. Alas, Crimson Cauldron was the first to sense how terrifying it was.

"Run!" He warned but it was too late.

"Ahh!" Ruyi and the crown prince bellowed after being engulfed by flames.

"Azure Freeze!" Frost encapsulated them with a special frost, hoping to extinguish the flames.

Her azure frost could dispel solar flames instantly but instantly evaporated in this case. Frost couldn't believe it - how could one fire wisp burn her spell to nothingness?

"Ahh!" The two turned to ashes despite her involvement.

"Impossible!" The crowd shouted.

One wisp took down two pseudo-emperors instantly. They had no chance to resist and a nine-fruit emperor couldn't save them.

"How dare you?!" Crimson Cauldron was furious and summoned his fate weapon - Crimson Imperial Cauldron. His flames surged in harmony.
